parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: This is the rotation blade of a knife, made of stainless steel, typically sharp and metallic with a length of about 10 cm.
parts.Functional_description: The blade is used for cutting, slicing, or chopping materials. It is the primary functional part of the knife.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or fold relative to the base body in folding knives, but remains fixed in non-folding designs.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or handle of the knife, made of durable plastic, approximately 12 cm long, designed for comfortable grip.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides a secure and ergonomic grip for the user, ensuring control and safety during cutting operations.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main support structure for the blade.
